_comment: Dedicated ZAP test users. Credentials match those declared in .zap/contexts/ovds.context and seeded by scripts/seed-zap-test-users-db.mjs. Rotate after each security assessment.

ovds_test_users.name: Normal Employee
ovds_test_users.description: Standard employee with basic access to HR, accounting, and reporting modules

ovds_test_users.name: System Administrator
ovds_test_users.description: Full administrative access to all system settings, user management, and configuration

ovds_test_users.name: Disabled Account
ovds_test_users.description: Disabled account used to verify access control rejects disabled credentials

notes: These are dedicated test accounts for security scanning only.
Do not use production credentials or personal accounts.
Passwords are rotated after each security assessment.
Create additional role-specific accounts as needed for authorization testing.
disabled_user intentionally has enabled=false — login attempts must be rejected.
